subject: Sage Systems — MSA + Order Form: publicity, logo use & evidence coordination
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Amira Nunez <amira@sagesys.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sage Systems — MSA + Order Form: publicity, logo use & evidence coordination

Hi Amira —

Thanks for the quick negotiations so far. Attached are our current redlines for the MSA and the Order Form (see attachments). Two items we want to align on before finalizing:

1) Publicity / press mention language in the Order Form. We currently have a single-line "Customer may be listed as a reference" clause; legal asks for clarity on embargo windows and approval workflow.
2) Logo usage and quote approval. We usually require a short approval window and a template for the quote.

Can you confirm what Sage needs to sign off on quote text and logo usage? For audit/evidence we can provide: draft press release, screenshot of the hosted mention, and a copy of our asset usage that shows the logo file we used. If you have a standard checklist (e.g., marketing sign-off + CMO approval), send it over and we will incorporate.

Attachments: Sage_MSA_redline_20270228.pdf, OrderForm_v3-redlines.docx

Goal: get this locked before signatures on the deal (target close: 03/05). If there are any non-starters in our redlines re: publicity, flag them here and we can propose language.

Thanks —
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Sage_MSA_redline_20270228.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: OrderForm_v3-redlines.docx (docx)]

From: Amira Nunez <amira@sagesys.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Sage Systems Legal <legal@sagesys.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sage Systems — MSA + Order Form: publicity, logo use & evidence coordination

Priyom —

Thanks for sending — our legal and marketing teams reviewed. High level: we are open to being a reference, but we have a few mandatory controls.

- Embargo: we require a 30-calendar-day embargo from contract signature for any press release that mentions Sage.
- Pre-approval: we need written approval of the exact quote and the final press release (CMO or delegated marketing lead).
- Logo: permitted only under our Brand Guidelines; we need to review the exact logo file usage and the landing page where it will appear.
- Limited attribution: we prefer a short case study or customer blurb rather than a headline announcement.

For evidence we accept: draft press release PDF with metadata, screenshot of the placement, and an executed reference approval form (we can provide). I attached our publicity guidelines for reference.

If Redwood can accept a 30-day embargo, pre-approval workflow, and the requirement that logos follow our Brand Guidelines, we can sign off. Otherwise we will need to remove the open "reference" language from the Order Form.

Appreciate you looping in legal; copying them for any clause-specific redlines.

Best,
Amira Nunez
Director, Strategic Partnerships — Sage Systems
[Attachment: Sage_publicity_guidelines.pdf (pdf)]

Subject: Re: Sage Systems — MSA + Order Form: publicity, logo use & evidence coordination

Amira —

Appreciate the clarity and the guidelines doc. Kimberly and I discussed internally and we want to propose a pragmatic compromise that keeps the reference value for both sides and avoids delaying signing:

- Embargo: Redwood can accept a 14-calendar-day embargo (instead of 30) for press releases that include minimal mention of Sage ("customer of Redwood Inference"), provided Sage provides written sign-off on the final release.
- Quote: Redwood will provide suggested short quote text (<=25 words). Any edits to the quote must be limited to factual corrections; substantive changes require approval and will be subject to your CMO sign-off.
- Logo use: limited to a single logo instance on our customer page and one marketing PDF. We'll submit the exact artwork and URL for your review prior to publication.
- Evidence: Redwood will provide a PDF of the final press release, screenshot(s) of live placement, and the executed approval email chain.

If Sage agrees to the 14-day window we will accept the publicity language in the Order Form. If you need the full 30 days, we can propose language that adds an explicit approval step but keeps the Order Form reference so the commercial team can proceed.

Karthik: can you confirm sales is okay with the 14-day compromise?
Kimberly: please weigh in if that language is acceptable from a legal perspective — I've attached the original redlines again.

Thanks —
Priyom

Amira / Priyom / Karthik —

Thanks — I reviewed amira's note and Priyom's suggested compromise. From a contract standpoint I propose the following clean clause we can insert into the Order Form / MSA to capture the agreement and the evidence workflow:

"Publicity and References: Customer agrees that Vendor may identify Customer as a customer of Vendor and use Customer's name and logo solely as set forth in this Section. Vendor will provide Customer a draft press release and any proposed quote at least fourteen (14) calendar days prior to publication. Customer will provide written approval or requested edits within fourteen (14) calendar days of receipt. Customer's written approval is required for any use of Customer's logo, which must comply with Customer's Brand Guidelines. Evidence of approval will be the executed approval email or a signed reference form."
We will accept the 14-day timelines as the minimum if Sage confirms in writing that marketing/delegated approver will respond within that window. If Sage requires a 30-calendar-day embargo, we can include that as an alternate option (Customer selects 30 days) but it will push the commercial timeline by the difference.

Separately, we will provide the SOC 2 Artifact request schedule to your security folks post-signature; if you need evidence before signature we can share a SOC 2 summary and a timeframe for the full evidence pack.

If that clause looks ok to you, Amira, I'll prepare a tracked change and attach a short clause file.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_publicity_clause_v1.docx (docx)]
